clusters.headline: Severe Storms Destabilize Displacement Camps Throughout Gaza Strip
aiSummaryBullets: Torrential rains have inundated tens of thousands of makeshift tents housing displaced persons throughout the Gaza Strip.
Local health authorities confirmed four fatalities, including three children, following the collapse of a sand embankment onto shelter sites.

clusters.headline: Severe Storms Inundate Over 70,000 Refugee Tents Across Gaza Strip
aiSummaryBullets: Winter storms in the eastern Mediterranean have caused widespread flooding throughout refugee camps in the Gaza Strip.
Local civil defense authorities have officially declared a state of maximum emergency due to the severe weather conditions.

clusters.headline: Donald Trump Urges Benjamin Netanyahu To Advance Gaza Peace Plan
aiSummaryBullets: President Donald Trump has called on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to begin implementing peace initiatives for Gaza.
The request follows the recent conclusion of parliamentary elections held in Israel.
